note: Curated from individual Wikimedia Commons file pages; author, license, and source page recorded per file. No site changes have been made. To apply, first refresh the live attraction audit and post snapshots, then import with credit metadata and set _thumbnail_id using the safe agent update route. Do not run tools/photos/import_photos.py unchanged: it normalizes Wikimedia thumbnail URLs to originals, and the Chitgar original exceeds the site's 10 MB remote-fetch limit.
